title: Sign in
lead: Save your projects and come back to them. We email you a link, no password.
consent: By signing in you agree to how we handle your data, see our <privacy>privacy notice</privacy>.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.body: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once and expires in an hour.

errors.rateLimited: Too many links sent. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.failed: We could not send the link. Try again, or continue with Google.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is not available on this demo build.
errors.link: That sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.google: Google sign-in did not work. Try again, or use your email.
